description: Search fountain pen inks by brand or name (for example "iroshizuku" or "pilot kon-peki"). match tells what came back: "exact" for name matches; "color" when no name matched but the query is a color, so these are inks of that color; "closest" when the spelling was off, so inks holds the closest name and similar_inks the inks like it; "none" when nothing was found.

query.description: Brand and/or ink name, in English or as written on the bottle

name: search_inks
title: Search inks by name
